summary: Completed first-pass MVP testing for EDUVINCI marketing site. All 8 backend pytest cases pass and all critical frontend flows (home hero, nav, EN/TR toggle, consultation/webinar/contact form submissions, blog list+detail, Italy universities city filter, mobile sticky CTA, mobile hamburger menu) work end-to-end.

minor.issue: Review request referenced slug 'eduvinci-admissions' for detail check, but it is not part of the seed. Seeded slugs are: italyada-tip-okumak-imat-rehberi, polimi-polito-til-i-basvurusu, dsu-burs-isee-italya-ogrenci, torino-milano-ogrenci-konaklama. Test was adjusted to use a real seeded slug.

design_issues.screen: About / Italy Education / Webinar / Contact / Success Stories pages
issues: All these inner pages render the same homepage hero h1 ('İtalya'da eğitim yolculuğunuzu doğru bilgiyle yönetiyoruz.') as their first h1 instead of a page-specific h1. Navigation/URL routing is correct, but each page should have a unique heading reflecting its own topic (e.g., 'Hizmetler', 'Webinar', 'İletişim'). This hurts SEO and information scent.

Framer-motion warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute' on multiple pages — cosmetic but should be addressed by giving the scroll target container a non-static position.

action_items: Give each inner page (About, Services, ItalyEducation, SuccessStories, Webinar, Blog, Contact) its own distinct page-level h1 instead of reusing the homepage hero title.
Fix framer-motion 'non-static position' warning by adding position:relative on the scroll-tracked container.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses motor + Pydantic v2 cleanly; all responses exclude MongoDB _id via projection — good.
Blog seed runs on @app.on_event('startup'); deprecated in FastAPI 0.110+. Consider migrating to lifespan handlers.
CORS uses allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; if cookies are not needed this is fine, but the combination is technically invalid.

Frontend MobileCtaBar puts data-testid on a wrapper div, not on the actual <Link>. Either OK, but querying the anchor requires '[data-testid=...] a'. Consider moving data-testid onto the Link for direct selection.
ConsultationForm uses HTML required + type=email, which is the only client-side validation. Acceptable given backend validates as well.
Several inner pages appear to reuse t('hero.title') as their main heading (see design issue) — this looks like a copy/paste oversight.
seed_data_creation: Created test rows via API (TEST_ prefix) for consultations/webinars/contacts; safe to leave. Blog posts are auto-seeded by backend startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py covers root, consultations (create+list+422), webinar-registrations, contacts, blog list, blog detail, blog 404. Frontend Playwright flows covered: hero+pills, 7 nav links, primary CTA, EN/TR toggle (writes ev-lang to localStorage), consultation/webinar/contact form POSTs (all 200), blog index→detail, Italy /italyada-egitim city filter (SELECT element, Torino reduces 6→2 cards), 390px sticky-mobile-cta (link inside has href=/iletisim — note data-testid is on wrapper div), mobile hamburger open/close. Main remaining product issue: inner pages share the homepage hero h1.
rca of the issue: Inner pages share the same h1 because their hero sections appear to call the same i18n key t('hero.title') rather than page-specific titles. Fix: introduce per-page title keys in /app/frontend/src/i18n/translations.js and reference them from each page component (Services.jsx, ItalyEducation.jsx, Webinar.jsx, Contact.jsx, About.jsx, SuccessStories.jsx).
